notes.title: 💥 RippleFX is OUT NOW! New Visualizers, Fixes, and Performance Boosts!
notes.content:
[h1]🎧 Hello Rippers! 🎧[/h1]

[b]RippleFX is out.[/b] Here’s what’s new and improved:
[hr][/hr][h2]🔹 NEW VISUALIZER SYSTEMS[/h2]

🌀 [b]Waterball[/b] – Smooth, fluid, and dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979330/98057e9a4ca6c84f9c7747eb8d6469e20106643f.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]🎹 [b]Simple Piano[/b] – A streamlined version for better performance.

[b]✔ Improved piano performance.[/b]
[b]✔ Resolution scaling added to the main menu.[/b]
[b]✔ Smarter particle limiter[/b]

notes.title: Furball Debuts! System Upgrades and Experimental Features 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Rippers! 🎧[/h1]

[h2]What I’ve Been Working On[/h2]

Some exciting updates are now live in the playtest!

[b]🎉 Furball is here.[/b]  
This new system is less demanding than the particle systems, making it a great option for smoother performance.

[b]🚀 Improved Systems and Styles Tabs.[/b]  
The Systems and Styles tabs got a major upgrade:  
[list]
[*]Premade styles are now included, which can be mixed and matched with select systems.  
[*]Style saving now takes a screenshot for easy reference.  
[*]A ton of polish has been added for smoother navigation.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979330/aba01b66f6ec0e52817be2089be5eee7c0d287a0.jpg[/img]

[b]🌀 Parameter Randomizer (Experimental).[/b]  
I’m testing out a randomizer feature—just press [b]R[/b] to shake things up.  
[i]Note:[/i] Some combinations might break the visualizer. If that happens:  
[list]
[*]Reselect the system.  
[*]Or press [b]R[/b] again to fix it.  
[/list]

[b]⚙️ Radial Visualizer Fixes.[/b]  
Previously non-functional sliders on the radial visualizer, like [b]spacing[/b], now properly control the radius as intended.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

- A better demo experience.  
- More systems and parameters for deeper customization.  
- More polish and stability.

[b]🛠️ Speedometer Tab Removed.[/b]  
The speedometer was causing too many issues and instability, so I’ve decided to remove it for now. It would need far more work than expected to function properly.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]

- Furball doesn’t currently work with the microphone input.  

If you encounter crashes, stability issues, or anything else, please let me know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2920750/discussions/?snr=2___]feedback section[/url].

notes.title: Fluffy Furball Visualizer Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Rippers! 🎧[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Release Update: A Little More Time to Shine[/b][/h2]
Bad news first—I've decided to delay the release from December to March. Why? Because RippleFX needs more polish and a few extra visualizer options to be the best it can be.

The good news? The playtest is still live, so you can jump in, try it out, and share your feedback. Every bit helps me improve!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979330/2416600a78817f9cd3ac68a858579899b09c5a20.gif[/img]

Thanks for sticking around and supporting RippleFX—it means a lot. Let’s make this the best visualizer experience together!

notes.title: RippleFX Playtest is Live: New Features & Future Plans!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Rippers![/b][/h1]

[h3][b]Playtest is Live![/b][/h3]
I’m excited to announce that the [b]RippleFX Playtest[/b] is live now and will run 2 weeks until September 10. This playtest is all about testing how the visualizer reacts to music across different PC setups. Since audio drivers, equalizers, and hardware configurations can impact how the visualizer responds to various frequencies.

Join the playtest now on the [b]RippleFX Steam page[/b] and help me shape the future of RippleFX.

[h3][b]What I’ve Been Working On These Past Few Months:[/b][/h3]
Added [b]auto audio sensitivity[/b], which adjusts the visualizer’s responsiveness based on the loudness of your music.

Added a [b]performance fallback[/b] system that reduces the maximum number of particles if the FPS drops below 45. The lower the FPS, the fewer particles are spawned—no more freezes or crashes!

Made [b]radial visualizer[/b] but still ironing out some issues. I really like how it turned out, here is a short preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44979330/369e63e7695f37a60e461961824e385dfc120b2c.gif[/img]

Drastically improved performance and fixed an issue where FPS would degrade over time until unusable.

Added a [b]main menu[/b].

Lots of [b]testing and refining[/b] to make everything smoother.

[h3][b]Things I am Planning to Add but Don't Promise I Will :D[/b][/h3]
Currently working on a [b]save system and presets[/b].
Custom audio sensitivity settings for each emitter.
More customization options.
Local music player
FSR frame generation.
A less demanding 2D visualizer.
A tutorial.

[h3][b]Known Issues/Bugs:[/b][/h3]
Hz ranges are interactable but don’t do anything yet.
Performance drops at the start when loading particles into VRAM.
When switching from MIC to WAC, you might need to wait a bit or manually increase the audio sensitivity to get it going.

I’d love your input on what features or changes you’d like to see next—let me know your thoughts!

Since you made it to the end, here’s a secret DEV tech: you can use NUM2 to test the radial visualizer and NUM1 to switch back, but it doesn’t save and resets every time you use the shortcut.

[b]Sorry for the long time between updates, sometimes life happens, sometimes work happens :D[/b]

notes.title: Enhanced UI, Performance, and Music Analysis!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
update!

New User Interface: It’s slicker, easier to use, and just looks way cooler. Hope you like it!

Performance Optimization: Smoother visuals and a better overall experience.

Improved Music Analysis: I’ve tweaked the music analysis algorithms, so now the visualizer reacts even better to the beats. It’s like the visuals are dancing along with the music!

Quality of Life Improvements: You can now use the mouse wheel to adjust customization values. It’s a small thing, but it feels really nice and intuitive.
But here’s the best part: You no longer need to setup Windows submix anymore. I’ve managed to get the audio working right out of the box without the submix. This was a huge challenge for me, but I’m really proud of how it turned out.

New Features: I’ve added a speedometer dashboard for more music visualization and you can now customize each emitter color individually.
